== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Haresh is known as the [[Arbiter]] of Betrayal. Introduced by [[Grandmaster Naraka]], he functions as a [[judge]] who pronounces death sentences upon those he deems guilty of violating trust. He utilizes an ash-gray rope to carry out these executions, demonstrating a proficiency for tying complex knots. During his actions, he has been observed dragging individuals toward him and confronting figures such as King Zakareth VI{{!}}King Zakareth and the Heir of [[Damasca]], whom he accuses of betrayal.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Haresh is an elderly, non-human being with red skin. He carries a long noose crafted from ash that is gray in color.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As an [[Arbiter]], he holds the title of the [[Arbiter]] of Betrayal. He utilizes an ash-gray rope in his actions.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Haresh is a non-human, red-skinned old man who serves as an [[Arbiter]]. Known specifically as the [[Arbiter]] of Betrayal, he carries a long noose crafted from ash. This ash-gray rope serves as his distinct tool.}}
